builder_observations.author: Madhu Guru
builder_observations.content: Madhu Guru 说，经历过多次前沿模型发布评审后，他理解参与者的压力：发布 LLM 不是传统软件上线，而是在无限用例和失败模式的黑箱上做权衡，需要评测、红队和多轮候选模型讨论。
builder_observations.original_text: Having been through many frontier model launch reviews, I have empathy for everyone involved. Launching an LLM isn't like shipping traditional software - you're making a decision about a black box with effectively infinite use cases and infinite failure modes. The tradeoffs are hard - every increase in capability expands the space of both valuable use cases and potential misuse. As a lab, you build extensive evals, you red-team, you iterate on the model. You debate tradeoffs across candidate ch...
builder_observations.translation: Madhu Guru 说，经历过多次前沿模型发布评审后，他理解参与者的压力：发布 LLM 不是传统软件上线，而是在无限用例和失败模式的黑箱上做权衡，需要评测、红队和多轮候选模型讨论。

builder_observations.author: Aaron Levie
builder_observations.content: Aaron Levie 认为 Fable 出口管制争议反而让 AI 监管讨论更具体：如果监管落在模型层而不是应用层，政府将能按自身掌握的因素决定模型何时向公众发布。
builder_observations.original_text: This whole Fable export control situation is actually net positive to regulation discourse. It’s an early peek into what AI regulation would end up looking like at scale when enacted at the model layer instead of the specific application of the AI. The government would have sole discretion over when a model can be released to the to public, based on a bunch of factors that they inherently control. In this case, based on the available reporting, the risk is that the model can be jailbroken to de...
builder_observations.translation: Aaron Levie 认为 Fable 出口管制争议反而让 AI 监管讨论更具体：如果监管落在模型层而不是应用层，政府将能按自身掌握的因素决定模型何时向公众发布。

builder_observations.author: Aaron Levie
builder_observations.content: Aaron Levie 说，这不必被理解成复杂阴谋；对 AI 模型做 jailbreak 研究很常见，而且这类研究本来就会分享给政府。他也不认为 Amazon 预设了这样的后续动作。
builder_observations.original_text: Everyone thinks this is some kind of 4D chess or conspiracy. But it’s quite standard to try and jailbreak AI models, and by definition they would share that research with the government given that’s whole point. I don’t think Amazon assumed this would be the next move. https://t.co/DizjwNcaLG
builder_observations.translation: Aaron Levie 说，这不必被理解成复杂阴谋；对 AI 模型做 jailbreak 研究很常见，而且这类研究本来就会分享给政府。他也不认为 Amazon 预设了这样的后续动作。

builder_observations.author: Aaron Levie
builder_observations.content: Aaron Levie 认为，能按任务把请求路由到最合适 AI 模型的层会变得更有价值：同一工作流里可能用前沿模型做规划和审查，再用开源或低价模型处理大量执行环节。
builder_observations.original_text: The layer that can route to the best AI model for the particular job is going to increase in value substantially. There are at least 3 big reasons: * Cost optimization: there are plenty of use cases where you need frontier intelligence for some tasks and something far cheaper for others. Even in the same task you may use frontier intelligence for planning and review of the work, but an OSS or cheaper model for the bulk of the workload. This is going to be standard across large buckets of work g...
builder_observations.translation: Aaron Levie 认为，能按任务把请求路由到最合适 AI 模型的层会变得更有价值：同一工作流里可能用前沿模型做规划和审查，再用开源或低价模型处理大量执行环节。
